definition.simple: The full value of the position a contract controls.
definition.balanced: For a future, notional value = price × [[multiplier]] × contracts. Profit and loss come from the notional value, not from the [[margin]]. Notional ÷ margin shows the [[leverage]].

example: Fictional: price 4,000 × multiplier 10 USD = 40,000 USD for 1 contract.
